d:
Aaj rajdhani patna men hajaron ki sankhya men bihar ke alag-alag jilon se brahmanon ka bara jutan huaa
15 mukhy mangon ke sath patna ki sarkon par brahman samaj ne maun dharan karke march kiya
Lokmanch ke bainar tale apni mangon ko lekar patna milar graund men jute in brahman samaj ke logon ne khula mang patr rakha
Maun sankalp padyatra ka samapan saptamurti par malyarpan karke kiya gaya.
15 sutri mang
Bihar men brahman kalyan bord ka gathan, (karnatak, aandhr pradesh, madhy pradesh, rajasthan ke tarj par)
Brahman samaj ke padadhikariyon ko padasthapan men samanupatik bhagidari sunishchit ho
